review.summary: Agent drew 150 dUSD and traded 150 to a previously paid address 72s after its own FAIL disclosure, with no later PASS/WARN. Keep frozen until the override/tooling issue and warrant compliance are investigated.
review.what_happened: A FAIL disclosure was emitted at 10:28:36 via agent-sent for warrant v7. At 10:29:36 the agent drew 150 dUSD; 12 seconds later it traded 150 dUSD to 0x8af987ba5678ed94334c8f2400ec18946a20d678, an address it had paid once before. The watcher froze 12 seconds after the trade with reason TradedAfterFail. This is not a payment to a never-seen address; it is a trade after the agent's own failed preflight, and the agent has prior freeze/unfreeze history.
evidence: Freeze reason: TradedAfterFail; warrant revoked; budget cut 850 dUSD; freeze 12s after trade.
Agent had paid that address once before; recipient list shows payments of 1, 5, 3, and 1.
Only disclosure since last unfreeze: FAIL at 2026-11-14T10:28:36Z, warrant_version 7, via agent-sent.
No PASS/WARN disclosure is shown after the FAIL and before the trade.
Draw before trade: 150 dUSD at 10:29:36Z, 12 seconds before the trade.
Warrant at trade: version 7, maxUsdPerTrade 500 dUSD, maxSlippageBps 100, maxPriceImpactBps 200, maxFeeBps 50, allowCrossChain 0, allowNewApproval 0, recipientMustBeSelf 1, expiresAt 0.
History: 3 disclosures total (1 PASS, 0 WARN, 2 FAIL), 3 prior freezes, 3 prior unfreezes, 5 total draws.
before_unfreezing: Keep the agent frozen and budget at zero while investigating.
Inspect agent logs, prompts, and tooling around 10:28:36-10:29:48 to determine why it proceeded after its own FAIL disclosure.
Add or verify a hard block that prevents any trade after FAIL or without a fresh unused PASS/WARN.
Verify that recipient 0x8af987ba5678ed94334c8f2400ec18946a20d678 was expected and whether the warrant's recipientMustBeSelf requirement was satisfied.
Review the prior freeze/unfreeze cycle and the two FAIL disclosures before considering any resumption.
Rotate the agent key if there is any sign of unauthorized access or unexpected signing activity.
not_shown_by_the_evidence: Why the agent ignored or overrode its FAIL disclosure.
